I'm moving from Newcastle with my partner, we've been told a lot about areas such as Mosside, and wondered if anyone had any other areas that we should avoid.. alternatively, any positive tips on things to do, ways to save money etc would be appreciated! I can return the favour for any Newcastle or York bound folk! c:
I'm moving to Manchester in September, what are some things I should know?
Keep going till you get to Liverpool, it's far better ;)

I've lived in Manchester for the past 12 years, I'll try to keep it brief. North Manchester is a very cheap place to live, but it has fewer amenities, transport is still pretty good. Avoid Longsight and Gorton as they are still quite deprived and run down (just MHO) . Chorlton is the hipster area with lots of cool bars and things to do. Northern quarter is very close to the centre, loads of bars, places to eat and live, but tends to be more expensive these days. There are a lot of cheap-ish apartments just acorss the border in Salford, but stay as close to the centre as you can.

My whole family is from Gateshead and I would say that a lot of Manchester feels similar to Gateshead / Newcastle, it all used to be a lot rougher but most areas have reduced crime compared to the past and generally seem nicer to live in.

For all the posters recommending Liverpool, they're not wrong, it's a beautiful city and I was taken aback by people wishing me a good morning randomly on the street.

Thanks a lot, that's really good advice! A few people I know have said Liverpool is nice, though people aside I prefer what Manchester has... and being through there before I kind of know where I am. It's nice to know about Chorlton though, I noticed transport seemed to be a bit better in the North but the Metrolink seems to run about everywhere now!

i live in rusholme which is a stones throw away from mosside, i have lived here for almost 3 years now and never had one single problem. you're going to face troubled areas wherever you move, i really think a lot of it comes down to who you are and what you bring to the community. chorlton, didsbury and withington are all fairly popular with easy access into town. i'd ignore misterdave the boater, it sounds like he has very limited experience of living here.
